LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a summary of a quote with quote details, product images, and a link to view full details.

property.name: quote
property.label: Quote Data Expression
property.description: The quote summary data to display

property.name: viewDetailsLinkLabel
property.label: View Details Link Text
property.description: Text displayed for the link to view full quote details

property.name: quoteSummaryFieldMapping
property.label: Quote Summary Fields
property.description: JSON array of fields to display in the quote summary

property.name: headerBgColor
property.label: Header Background Color
property.description: Background color for the quote summary header

property.name: borderColor
property.label: Border Color
property.description: Border color for the quote summary card

property.name: imageSize
property.label: Image Size
property.description: How product images should be sized (cover or contain)

property.name: imageAspectRatio
property.label: Image Aspect Ratio
property.description: Aspect ratio for product images (e.g., 1 for square, 1.5 for 3:2)
